login.title: Enter the System
login.subtitle: We will email you a sign-in link. No password needed.
login.sent: [System] Email sent. Open it and click the link — any browser or phone works.
login.linkFailed: the link did not work or has expired. Request a new one.
login.sentWithCode: [System] Email sent. Enter the code from it or click the link.

system.slotUnlockedMain: [System] Main skill slot unlocked! Main slots: {total}
system.slotUnlockedSecondary: [System] Secondary skill slot unlocked! Secondary slots: {total}
system.skillOffer: [System] Recurring activity detected. Skill available: “{skill}”. Take it?
system.unfoldAvailable: [System] Attribute “{attribute}” is ready to unfold: {parts}. Unfold?

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.slots_full: No free slots. Move or archive another skill first.
errors.slot_cooldown: A skill can change slots once every 7 days.
errors.bad_milestone: This specialization milestone is not available.

age.title: How old are you?
age.hint: Only a range: it sets the tone and limits.

occupation.title: What do you mostly do right now?

groups.title: What field are you in?
groups.hint: Pick several if needed. The System suggests starter skills from them.

skills.title: What can you already do?
skills.hint: These are dormant skills: experience from before the app. They take no slot until they wake up, then catch up with x5 XP.
skills.name: Skill
skills.broad: Name it broadly, like a CV skill: Programming, not Python.

goals.title: What do you want to level up?
goals.hint: Up to three goals. They shape the System hints.

starter.title: Starter skills
starter.hint: Tap: main slot. Tap again: secondary. Third tap: remove.

assessment.title: Character assessment
assessment.hint: The System rates Body, Mind and Spirit from your experience. Then you can move up to 5 points.
assessment.balance: The total must stay the same: take a point from another attribute.
assessment.calibrate: Points you can still move: {left}. Or keep it as is.

name.title: Character name
name.hint: How the System will address you.
name.label: Game name

status.classPending: Class will be revealed in the next version
status.restAdvice: [System] HP is low. Rest is recommended.
status.stars: {stars} of 10 stars to the next point
status.unfoldReadinessHint: Unfold requires: level 20, 6000 XP in the attribute, 30 active days

wellbeing.sleep: How long did you sleep last night?

offer.text: [System] Recurring activity detected. Skill available: {name}. Take it?

specialization.text: [System] Skill {skill} reached level {milestone}. Choose a specialization.
specialization.hint: A specialization labels the skill and gives +10% XP to matching activities. The System will suggest options in the next version.
specialization.label: Specialization name

unfold.irreversible: Unfolding is permanent. For 7 days after you can move 2 points.

calibration.title: Calibration after unfolding
calibration.hint: Points left: {points}. The total stays the same.

skills.title: Skills
skills.empty: No skills yet. Log your first activity.

tags.hint: Which attributes does this skill train? Experience is recalculated for its whole history.

journal.title: Journal
journal.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? Experience will be recalculated.

log.title: Log activity
log.search: Find a skill or name something new
log.noSkills: No skills yet. Just name the activity.
log.newHint: A new activity becomes a candidate: when it repeats, the System will offer a skill.
log.focusHint: Count the time you were actually focused, not the whole span.
